title: poa attenuata subsp. botryoides
intro: Poa attenuata subsp. botryoides, commonly known as Poa botryoides, is a subspecies of the Poa attenuata plant, a type of grass native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Poa botryoides include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
